description.text: The sixth Black & White set, released on 15 August 2012 with 128 cards: 124 and four secret Shiny rares, Serperior, Reuniclus, Krookodile and an English-only Rayquaza. It brought in the Dragon type, the first new type in more than a decade, with more than 15 Dragon Pokémon whose attacks call for two kinds of Energy, among them Rayquaza-EX, Giratina-EX, Garchomp and Hydreigon, and Pokémon from outside Unova such as Mew-EX and Ho-Oh-EX. Its theme decks are DragonSnarl and DragonSpeed.
